title: Speaking — Personal goals
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on personal goals.

questions: When do you normally walk rather than take transport?
Which local route do you enjoy walking along?
Do you usually walk alone or with someone?
What would encourage you to walk more where you live?
Do you usually set yourself goals?
How do you remember what you want to achieve?

part2.topic: Describe a goal that took longer to achieve than you expected.
points: how you kept working on it
part2.closing: and explain what you learned about setting achievable goals.

questions: Can public competition help people achieve personal goals?
How can schools encourage ambition without making students fear failure?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to personal goals?
